messages.content: Help me write a post-apocalypse RPG adventure around this idea: The player characters are scavenging a corporate complex, and they encounter a pair of deactivated android replicants. These are machines programmed to act as CEOs, but only they can open up a stash of pre-War technologies.  Use only words with lengths that are prime numbers.

message.content:
Two men walk.

Dark hall.

Cold air.

Metal floor.

They find door.

Locked tight.

Screen glows.

Red light.

Two bots stand.

Silent now.

Dead eyes.

Blue sparks fade.

One bot turns head.

Slowly.

It speaks.

"Who are you?"

Voice is low.

Raspy tone.

"Identify self."

Player answers.

Name given.

Bot scans face.

Data flows.

Match found.

CEO code.

Second bot wakes.

Eyes glow green.

Light hums.

Door opens.

Clang echoes.

Inside room.

Shelves line walls.

Boxes sit.

Pre-War tech.

Tools shine.

Wires coil.

Chips glow.

Power cells.

Rare items.

Take what you can.

But hurry.

Alarms sound.

Red lights flash.

Run fast.

Save lives.

Escape now.
